scripts.build: pnpm run generate && blume build && node scripts/headers.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run generate && blume validate --strict && node scripts/translations.mjs
scripts.translate: node scripts/translations.mjs --ledger && pnpm run generate && { blume translate --claude $DOCS_TRANSLATE_ARGS; code=$?; node scripts/typography.mjs && node scripts/translations.mjs --prune && pnpm run generate && exit $code; }
